title: Battle of Cempoala
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Cempoala", at revision 1370436634, opens: "The Battle of Cempoala was fought on 27 May 1520 at Cempoala, Mexico, between the forces of Pánfilo de Narváez and the forces of Hernán Cortés, which were supported by Chinantec warriors." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q97610233, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "event during the Conquest of Mexico". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
